title: Graft Biomechanics

positions.as_written: Expect fixation to be the limiting factor early and the graft later.
Read time zero testing as describing the day of surgery only.
Treat graft choice as a trade rather than a ranking.
Avoid allograft in young active patients, on registry failure data.
Read time zero comparisons as a small part of the clinical choice.
Plan revision graft choice from tunnel condition and available autograft rather than from the primary algorithm.
Stage with bone grafting where tunnels are wide or confluent.
Accept allograft more readily in revision and in multiligament reconstruction.
State that fixation choice in compromised bone rests on principle rather than data.
